scope: Assign prime p_(i+1) to the cell at route position i. Use exponents black/white in {0,1}, and uniform prime exponents >=2 for blue/yellow. Concatenate nothing: compare the one resulting integer in minimum decimal to the full field. Any positive-digit bijection a..i to1..9 with up to two zero-capable letters, both source directions. Routes are all distinct dihedral transforms/reversals of row-major, row-snake, clockwise inward spiral. Exact length bounds, no arbitrary prime cutoff.
